expectation: I expect an inked printing block ready for use with the press.

reason: Combine the paper with the inked block at the press to print the page.
expectation: I expect a printed page and completion of the current goal.

effect: The printed pages completed the final goal, showing how the inked block and press reproduce the same marks.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the prepared parts come together into printed pages.

mostWorthwhile.text: Printing the pages brought the paper, inked block and press together, with a clear explanation of why reproduction matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the inked block was a straightforward setup step rather than an especially interesting decision.

surprise.text: I was surprised that planks and iron produced the entire printing press in one combination.

arbitrary.text: Making a complete press from planks and iron felt somewhat compressed, even though the result explained its screw and pressing plate.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: assembling the printing process was satisfying, and I would be curious to see what comes next.
